cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Approve the Harmless Version
cards.instruction: Get approval for a harmless version of your plan, then gradually reveal what that approval now commits them to.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Can my aunt and uncle come for tea? I've put folded towels in the bath like yours.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tea's fine. My towels are there because the shower leaks, not for guests.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, keeping them handy. Aunt and Uncle can use the towels when they stay tonight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I said tea. And you can't offer them a shower that leaks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll give them your bathroom. You can explain the shower arrangement over the tea you approved.

reason: Replace the generic confidence prefaces with a specific misunderstood copied action whose correction shapes the Drive, keeping each alternative a different negotiation with B.
